title: The 4 Best Pressure Washers for Driveways
h1: The 4 Best Pressure Washers for Driveways
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for pressure washers for driveways, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pressure washers for driveways using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Greenworks Pro 2300 PSI Brushless Electric Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 2300 max PSI, 2.3 GPM max flow, TruBrushless motor with axial cam pump, 25-foot kink-resistant hose.
strengths: Highest PSI-and-GPM combination of the electric models in this list, cuts driveway time noticeably versus sub-2000 PSI units
Brushless motor is quieter and rated for a longer service life than standard brushed motors
10-inch wheels make it easy to roll along a long driveway without dragging
limitations: Bulkier and heavier than compact electric models like the Greenworks GPW1501
Still needs a household outlet within cord range, a limitation gas units do not have
No detergent auto-mix while spraying at full pressure, soap mode runs at reduced PSI
features: TruBrushless motor with axial cam pump

products.name: Simpson MegaShot MS60809-S Gas Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 3000 PSI, 2.4 GPM, Honda GCV170 engine, 25-foot MorFlex hose.
strengths: 3000 PSI and 2.4 GPM strip set-in oil stains and years of grime meaningfully faster than any electric model here
Honda engine has a strong reputation for reliability and easy pull-starts
No cord length limit, works anywhere on the property including detached driveways or gravel pads
limitations: Requires gas, oil checks, and seasonal storage prep (fuel stabilizer or draining)
Louder than every electric option in this list, a real factor in close-set neighborhoods
Heavier and bulkier to store than a wall-hung electric unit

products.name: Sun Joe SPX3000 Electric Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 2030 max PSI, 1.76 GPM max flow, 1800-Watt / 14.5-Amp motor, Dual detergent tanks.
strengths: Dual removable detergent tanks let you switch between a cleaner and a degreaser without refilling
TSS (Total Stop System) shuts the pump off automatically when the trigger is released, reducing wear
limitations: 2030 PSI is adequate but not class-leading, a two-car driveway with heavy staining takes longer than with the Greenworks Pro or Simpson MegaShot
Plastic wheels and frame feel less rugged than the Karcher K5's build
No surface cleaner included, needs to be purchased separately for faster coverage

products.name: AR Blue Clean AR383 Electric Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 1900 PSI, 1.51 GPM, 14-Amp motor, Bayonet-connect accessories.
strengths: Integrated hose reel keeps the 20-foot hose organized between uses
Compact enough to store on a shelf or in a corner of the garage
limitations: 1900 PSI is the lowest of the driveway-focused picks here, slower on set-in stains
Fewer nozzle options than the Sun Joe or Greenworks models
Bayonet connectors feel less secure than quick-connect fittings under prolonged use

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
